g.text: • Automated Urgency-First Triage for Rural Healthcare Helplines
Multi-lingual streaming audio speech or typed SMS queries
Translates Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi ➔ English for standardized high-accuracy triage
3-Way Fast Sequence Triage: Evaluates message urgency first before generating conversational responses.
Outperforms baseline TF-IDF + Logistic Regression (95% vs 88% Accuracy, 93% vs 87% Emergency Recall).
• Prioritizes call queue by distress severity
• Emergency UI banner trigger on mobile
• Strict prompt grounding on matched drugs
• Cardiology, Ortho, Ped, Derm, Neuro, ENT...
routed to General Medicine without failure
• Provides direct navigation link & slot booking
Dedicated system instructions per intent (directive brevity in emergencies; grounded context for drugs; clinic booking for appts).
Re-evaluates history on worsening indicators ("getting worse", "can't breathe") to instantly re-triage to Emergency.
Explicit emergency keywords bypass normal queues and immediately lock session into urgent directive mode.
Response Delivery, Slot Confirmation & Turn-by-Turn Nav
Voice TTS streamed back in caller's native regional language
Slot token generation, dept schedule & facility info
Direct Google Maps navigation deep-link to verified hospital
Instant 1-tap dial with patient coordinates pre-staged
Vaidyum Healthcare Helpline Architecture • DistilBERT + Gemini Flash Lite + DistilRoBERTa + Flutter Client
